## 2026-11-16 00:33 · claude-macbook · smooth-toasts-mod

2026-11-16: Owner saw vanilla music toast (NowPlayingToast, separate instance, untouched by Smooth Toasts) still on the left. Fixed in mc-spotify 1.0.2+26.3 (~/dev/mc-spotify, not git; pre-change backup in session scratchpad mc-spotify-backup.tgz): mixin cancels ToastManager.showNowPlayingToast and, if options.musicToast renderToast(), shows the track ("Artist - Title" from MusicManager.getCurrentMusicTranslationKey) in the shared TrackToast (music-notes icon instead of cover) -> lands in the Smooth Toasts deck. Verified in isolated client (entrypoint-stripped copy to avoid AppleScript prompts while Spotify runs). Installed 1.0.2, 1.0.1 renamed .disabled. Gotcha: `pgrep -fl java` prints the game's full launch line incl. the MC access token; use `pgrep -f ... >/dev/null` or `pgrep -l` instead.

## 2026-11-15 21:22 · claude-macbook · smooth-toasts-mod

Top-center collision facts: Jade (owner config overlayPosX 0.5/PosY 1.0/anchorY 0 = top-center, bossBarOverlapMode PUSH_DOWN) pushes itself below boss bars via BossHealthOverlayMixin capturing height into snownee.jade.util.ClientProxy yOffset; modes HIDE_BOSS_BAR/HIDE_TOOLTIP/NO_OPERATION/PUSH_DOWN. Fancy Toasts does NOT avoid: it hides the boss bar and toggles Jade displayTooltip off while its toast shows. Recommended to owner: toast on top of the top-center column (toast → boss bars → Jade), pushing the others down with eased offsets; needs a small Jade mixin to add our height to yOffset.
